cards.title: Up Day: Add Volume
cards.subtitle: If Today's Close > Yesterday's Close: OBV = Previous OBV + Today's Volume

cards.title: Down Day: Subtract Volume
cards.subtitle: If Today's Close < Yesterday's Close: OBV = Previous OBV - Today's Volume

cards.title: Flat Day: Neutral
cards.subtitle: If Today's Close == Yesterday's Close: OBV remains unchanged
